summary: Tested Admin orders panel enrichment + full Stripe checkout E2E. Backend regression on /api/admin/orders, /api/admin/orders/{sid}/status, /api/products, /api/payments/checkout all pass (6/6 pytest). Admin UI shows the 7 new columns (Réf., Date, Client, Articles, Montant, Paiement, Traitement), marc duvert paid order displays name+email in Client column, clicking the row opens order-detail-{session_id} with billing address '16 quai de polangis, 94340 Joinville le pont, FR'. Re-click collapses. Changing status via order-status-{sid} does NOT toggle the detail row (stopPropagation OK). Full E2E purchase completed with Stripe test card 4242… — new session cs_test_a1Y3s33juteMNFWAtJJUlyO5rb4LKNpUJxpjSnmzzz7PX5YhgtMjXfIcOU (22 €, Deadpool vs Punisher ×1). After /payment/success, backend flagged the order paid, decremented stock, and captured customer (Alice E2E Tester + email) + billing address (10 rue de Test E2E, 75001 Paris, FR). The GET /admin/orders response now includes customer + billing for this new order.

minor.issue: For the new E2E order, only 'billing' is populated; 'shipping' is empty. When the Stripe Checkout user leaves 'Billing info is same as shipping' checked (default), Stripe stores the address only in customer_details.address (billing) and does not populate shipping_details on the session, so Admin UI shows 'Adresse de livraison : Non renseignée'. Real delivery info is still available under the billing block. Not a code bug per se, but worth noting: consider falling back to display billing as shipping when shipping is missing, or explicitly log this in the UI.

action_items: (Optional UX) In Admin.jsx order detail, when o.shipping?.address is missing but o.billing?.address is present, display billing address as the shipping address (or add a note 'Livraison identique à la facturation') — otherwise users see 'Non renseignée' even though the address was captured.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:743 GET /admin/orders performs lazy Stripe retrieval for up to 10 paid orders lacking customer info on every call — fine at low volume; consider caching or a background one-shot backfill if the collection grows.
Admin.jsx is 587 lines; could be split (Orders tab / Stock tab into separate components) for maintainability, but not urgent.
seed_data_creation: One real Stripe test order was created during E2E and remains in the DB: session cs_test_a1Y3s33juteMNFWAtJJUlyO5rb4LKNpUJxpjSnmzzz7PX5YhgtMjXfIcOU, amount 22 €, product Deadpool vs Punisher (stock decremented to 0). Also toggled the 'Nova nº45' order status to 'Expédiée' during a stopPropagation test (visible in screenshot); harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin orders enrichment (customer/billing/shipping) is fully working end-to-end. Stripe hosted checkout automates cleanly with: (1) fill shipping name + set country FR + click 'Enter address manually' + fill line1/postal/city, (2) click Card radio, (3) fill 4242 card / 12/34 / 123, (4) 'Billing = shipping' is checked by default → resulting Stripe session stores address only in customer_details.address (surfaced as 'billing' in our schema). If the tester unchecks that box, both shipping and billing should populate. GET /admin/orders payload structure: {customer:{name,email,phone?}, billing:{name,address:{line1,line2,postal_code,city,state,country}}, shipping:{name,address:{...}}}.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works. Only minor UX gap noted about 'Adresse de livraison : Non renseignée' when Stripe checkbox 'Billing = shipping' is checked (default).
